user.title: Connect your B&D Smart Hub
user.description: Enter a registration/join code from the B&D app (wherever it shows the "add remote access" screen for a new device) and your B&D account password. These are used once, to register this Home Assistant instance as its own independent client - your account password is never stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not set up the hub - check the join code and password and try again. See the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: B&D Smart Hub polling schedule
init.description: How often to check the door/light status. A different, usually less frequent, interval can apply overnight.
